unit: deployment (chain, token), not unique economic asset or issuer

inventory.definition: all six-chain universe deployments, including convenience extras

ranked.definition: CoinGecko market-cap rows; main prevalence denominator before feature measurability

extras.definition: non-market-cap inclusion routes; separate descriptive convenience sample

top500_ranked.definition: per-chain market-cap ranks 1-500; cross-chain-test domain; OP has 198

top200_ranked.definition: top-200 candidate EOA table domain; OP has 198

ronin_rejecting.definition: saved restriction subset = baseline funded clean-recipient transfer succeeds, tested Ronin-exploiter recipient transfer reverts; original W1 amount

tornado_rejecting.definition: baseline funded clean-recipient transfer succeeds, tested formerly sanctioned Tornado router transfer reverts; original W1 amount

ronin_and_tornado_rejecting.definition: intersection of the two original W1 positive differential recipient tests; subset eligible for C10 restriction retest

tornado_only_rejecting.definition: Tornado-positive outside the Ronin-positive saved restriction subset; not included in C10 restriction retest

blocklist_capability.definition: strict static selector or answering blocklist view; capability, not observed transfer rejection

blocklist_any.definition: union of strict blocklist capability OR Ronin recipient revert OR Tornado recipient revert

original_security_tag.definition: original category_hint plus build.SEC_RX name/symbol classification; matrix categories preserved

tokenized_securities.definition: original security category supplemented with saved Base B20 stock-policy 5 deployments (F1); not a legal classification; explicit basis per token in tokenized_securities.csv

b20.definition: Base 0xB200 deployments in this universe; separate from external B20 factory census and 120-address SDN mirror

rank_1-100.definition: market-cap band 1-100; pooled over six chains

rank_101-500.definition: market-cap band 101-500; pooled over six chains

category_stablecoin.definition: saved universe category hint; can overlap other categories

category_wrapped_bridged.definition: saved universe category hint; can overlap other categories

ranked_ex_securities.definition: main market-cap rows minus the saved tokenized_security category; same per-chain rank positions

c10_eoa_candidates.definition: frozen pre-C19 top200_eoa candidate group supplied to C10; independent check verified 77 direct upgrades and left wrappers unresolved

tornado_context: Tornado Cash designations removed by OFAC on 2025-03-21; these tests do not establish current legal sanctions status or issuer intent

c10_reconciliation.note: Independent verification used one raw unit and clean-recipient controls on the Ronin-positive subset; original matrix positives and independent confirmations are distinct. See data/verify/claims/verdicts.csv N009/N010; retain the 10 unresolved controls.
